settings.title: More
settings.profile.name: Name
settings.profile.why: We only use this data to estimate how much you burn at rest.
settings.weight.typeHint: Tap a number to type it in.
settings.weight.maintainHint: Your goal equals your current weight, so you eat what you burn.
settings.activity.dayQuestion: What does your usual day look like?
settings.activity.dayWhy: Without workouts. It is one of the biggest factors in your goal: each level is about {kcal} kcal a day. When in doubt, pick the lower one.
settings.activity.trainingQuestion: How often do you work out each week?
settings.activity.trainingWhy: Count workouts of about 45 minutes or more. Each level is about {kcal} kcal a day.
settings.activity.day0Hint: Desk work, commuting by car, under 5k steps
settings.activity.day1Hint: Lots of walking, 5-8k steps, partly on your feet
settings.activity.training1Hint: Lighter workouts once or twice a week
settings.activity.training2Hint: Regular workouts most of the week
settings.targets.autoHint: From your data, activity and pace.
settings.breakdown.lead: Three steps from rest to your daily goal.
settings.breakdown.manual: Your goal is set by hand. Steps 1 and 2 show what you burn, and step 3 how your goal compares.
settings.breakdown.restingText: What you burn doing nothing. Based on weight, height, age and sex.
settings.breakdown.movementText: Daily movement and workouts add {percent}% to rest.
settings.breakdown.paceReduce: To lose {pace} kg a week, you eat {kcal} kcal less than maintenance.
settings.breakdown.paceBuild: To gain {pace} kg a week, you eat {kcal} kcal more than maintenance.
settings.breakdown.paceMaintain: You keep your weight, so nothing is added or taken away.
settings.meals.hint: Tap a name to rename it. Hidden meals do not show up in the plan.
settings.meals.reorderHint: Drag a meal by its handle.
settings.bodyWeight.lead: Enter what you weigh today. We use it for your daily goal and the date you reach your goal.
settings.goalPace.lead: You weigh {weight} kg now. Set the weight you want and how fast.
settings.app.productLanguageHint: The product database language decides how you search products and see their names. Only Polish is available for now.
settings.breakdown.whyProtein: {perKg} g per kg of body weight. Protects muscle and keeps you full longest.
settings.breakdown.whyFat: {perKg} g per kg of body weight. Needed for hormones and absorbing vitamins.
settings.breakdown.whyCarbs: The rest of the calories. The main fuel for daily movement and workouts.
settings.weight.recommendedWhyReduce: At this pace you lose weight without much hunger and protect your muscles.
settings.weight.recommendedWhyBuild: At a faster pace you gain more fat than muscle.
settings.weight.paceLockedWhy: You set your daily goal by hand to {kcal} kcal, so pace does not change calories. We calculate the date from your goal.
settings.activity.lockedWhy: Your daily goal is set by hand to {kcal} kcal. Activity is saved, but only used to explain your goal and the date.
settings.breakdown.manualLess: You eat {kcal} kcal less than maintenance, so you lose about {pace} kg a week.
settings.breakdown.manualMore: You eat {kcal} kcal more than maintenance, so you gain about {pace} kg a week.
settings.breakdown.manualSame: You eat what you burn, so you keep your weight.

onboarding.goal.buildHint: You eat a bit more than you burn
onboarding.body.question: Tell us about yourself

onboarding.target.questionBuild: How much do you want to gain?

onboarding.day.why: Without workouts. If unsure, pick the lower one.
onboarding.training.why: Workouts of about 45 minutes or more count.
